name: Expand the streets, rooftops and streets-later
body: Longer levels with a rhythm of traversal, puzzle, hazard, companion beat, collectible and rest, using the proven mechanics; leave room for photo sights.

comments.text: Filed 2026-11-16 before any code, from Dean's feedback that the Crimson and Thorn loop needs prototyping: more companion mechanics, more variety, a fuller level slice.

acceptance_criteria: Each level is longer and has the beats
